messages:
scan-bot: [ALERT] nightly-DAST: job=staging-dast-22 — keystore decrypt failed (KMS_ACCESS_DENIED). Evidence attached.
amy (SecEng): saw the alert. looks like the service account used by the scanner lost decrypt permission overnight :thinking:
amy (SecEng): grep'd the audit logs, there was an RBAC change at 02:58Z that touched keystore-access bindings. excerpt:```audit-log: timestamp=2026-03-20T02:58:07Z actor=terraform-ci user=infra-bot change=removed roles/keystore.decrypt from serviceAccount:scan-runner@redwood.internal```
raj (SRE): ugh. was that a deploy? infra-bot PR number?
amy (SecEng): link to PR in the audit metadata says https://git.internal/infra/terraform/changes/2345 — comment says "cleanup unused bindings". might be overzealous.
taylor (Eng): @amy can you paste the full KMS error from the DAST job? want to confirm it's RBAC + not a KMS key policy flip.
amy (SecEng): full error:```2026-03-20T03:01:12Z scanner[pid=42]: Decrypt failed: Request failed with status 403 - KMS_ACCESS_DENIED - principals=[serviceAccount:scan-runner@redwood.internal] key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/dast-key```
kevin (DevEx): if infra-bot removed the role via terraform, reverting the TF change should be the safe path. can we do a temporary grant so running pipelines don't stall? :sos:
raj (SRE): I can grant `roles/keystore.decrypt` to the service account for the staging project for 1 hour. will do short TTL and then we can decide a permanent fix.
amy (SecEng): thanks. action items: 1) raj temporary grant 2) infra team to revert/patch TF 3) security to confirm no unauthorized actors 4) add canary to pre-merge checks for keystore decrypt.
taylor (Eng): re: #4 — we can add a small pre-merge check that runs `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=/dev/null --key=...` using the same SA as scanner. would catch perms during PR.
kevin (DevEx): adding to CI checklist. created ticket: INF-1298 (link: https://tracker.redwood/INF-1298) to add a keystore smoke check in the PR pipeline.
amy (SecEng): on the security side, I scanned the audit trail for unusual actors. infra-bot did the change via a merged PR by user "chris.ops". PR looked legitimate but the change removed a binding that other jobs still needed. recommend we add a cross-check rule before any keystore binding removals.
raj (SRE): temporary grant applied at 03:12Z. staging DAST retried and passed at 03:20Z.
scan-bot: [INFO] retried job=staging-dast-22 — status=PASS after keystore grant.
taylor (Eng): for long-term: suggest tagging keystore-protected pipelines with `keystore-dep=true` in infra inventory and run a terraform plan validator that denies removal of decrypt role if any active consumers present.
amy (SecEng): also creating a small runbook for incident response when keystore perms change. needs to include: how to find impacted jobs, how to temporarily grant TTL creds, and audit followups. putting draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/runbooks/keystore-perm-drift (please review)
kevin (DevEx): can we add a CI guard that prevents merges that remove keystore bindings without an owner signoff? maybe require a `keystore-impact` label and 2 approvals.
amy (SecEng): yes. will coordinate with infra and product security to add label gating.
raj (SRE): final note: we should also detect RBAC drift via a nightly recipe that compares IAM bindings against inventory and alerts before a scan break. put up a small alert: AlertID=IAM-DRIFT-022.
taylor (Eng): assigning ownership: infra on terraform change rollback, sec on audit investigation, devex on CI guard, eng on smoke-check implementation. I can take the smoke-check PR.
amy (SecEng): thanks all. closing thread once INF-1298 and PR rollback are in. leaving evidence bundle in the ticket. :thumbsup:
